title: Layup: Orbit Fitting at LSST Scale
description: Layup is an open-source package for orbit determination at the scale of the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), and a companion to the Sorcha survey simulator. It is built on REBOUND/ASSIST for ephemeris-quality numerical integrations, with a C++ engine behind a Python command-line interface and API. Layup ingests optical astrometry in obs80 and ADES formats, radar range and Doppler measurements, streak (position and rate) measurements from shift-and-stack surveys, and observations from space-based platforms, and fits all of them with the same machinery. It offers a six-parameter Cartesian state and a Bernstein-Khushalani basis, fits gravitational and non-gravitational accelerations, and reports a full state covariance that it propagates through element and frame conversions and through ephemeris predictions.
